name: Disk Cleaner
description: Find what is eating your disk: scans caches, thumbnails, logs, trash and old downloads, shows the biggest space users and lets you delete them safely. The scan and delete operations stay in EthOS, where they run through the file service's path scope, so this package ships the desktop app only.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.0: first release. The Disk Cleaner desktop app moves out of the core install; every delete still goes through EthOS's scoped file service.
